marikana-lonmin.conditions_add: IFC committed in March 2007 to an equity investment of up to $50 million (with $15 million earmarked for community development) and a $100 million standby loan that was never disbursed and was cancelled in 2010. belgrade-vinca-landfill.conditions_add: IFC's agreed environmental and social action plan for the Belgrade waste-to-energy project committed the company to coordinate health and safety measures for waste pickers with the city, to have its contractors include ways of maximizing the hiring of waste pickers where feasible, and to hire an external consultant to monitor the resettlement and livelihood restoration plans and carry out a completion audit. IFC was considering loans of about EUR 70 million (A loan), EUR 25 million (B loan), EUR 35 million (parallel) and EUR 20 million (blended finance) (IFC, Environmental and Social Review Summary, Belgrade WtE).
